title: Industrial Asset Management with Wipro Industrial AssetsAI
summary: Wipro Industrial AssetsAI strengthens industrial asset management for asset intensive industries, improving operations, reliability, and asset performance at scale
body_markdown:
**Industrial-AssetsAI is a next-generation, AI-powered suite of solutions built using common components that transforms Industrial Operations from reactive to predictive and autonomous.**


Purpose-built for asset-intensive industries, Industrial-AssetsAI harnesses advanced AI technologies to tackle critical challenges such as unplanned downtime, underutilised assets, fragmented operations, and low workforce productivity.


By integrating intelligent asset performance, responsive production operations, and smart digital twin solutions, Industrial-AssetsAI delivers real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance, and autonomous control—ensuring maximum uptime and operational efficiency.


Backed by common data models and unified data platforms, the solution enables seamless integration and rapid deployment across manufacturing, utilities, and energy.


Among its many benefits, Industrial-AssetsAI delivers:


- AI-based real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance ensuring high uptime


- Autonomous operations driving efficiencies in production


- AI-driven simulations for higher asset uptime and efficiency
